cases.about: The report's two-item total is proved with a failing test, fixed in one comparison on bug-fixer's own branch, the suite passes, it is committed and never pushed.

inputs.issue: Two items of 10 cost 20 at checkout; the site says 10% off each item, so it should be 18.

call.old_string: return sum(prices) * 0.9 if len(prices) > 2 else sum(prices)
call.new_string: return sum(prices) * 0.9 if len(prices) > 1 else sum(prices)

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'shop' && pytest -q tests/test_cart.py::test_ten_percent_off_two_items && pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && git add -A && git commit -m 'Fix: 10% off two items (bug-fixer)'

script.say:
**Reproduced**
- tests/test_cart.py::test_ten_percent_off_two_items — assert 20 == 18

**Fix**
- The discount started at three items (`len(prices) > 2`), so two items paid full price; the docstring and the report say 10% off from two. cart.py: `> 2` → `> 1`.

**Tests**
- before: 1 passed; after: 2 passed — on branch bug-fixer/2026-10-28, committed 9f8e7d6; not pushed

## Report
- reproduced the issue with 1 test, fixed cart.py on bug-fixer/2026-10-28, committed it
